lines.text: Hi, how do I get to the park from here?
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: Go straight to the first corner.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Do I turn left at the corner?
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: Turn right at the corner, then turn left at the library.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Is the park far from the library?
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: No, it's just past the library on your right.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: So I turn right first and left at the library.
lines.speaker: Yan

lines.text: Yes. Look for the big green gate.
lines.speaker: Nora
